question: Once the case reached the court, the police washed their hands off it.
solution: अपनी जिम्मेदारी से हाथ वापस खींचना। Origin Story: Bible me Pontius Pilate ne Jesus ko saza sunane ke baad sabke samne haath dho (wash hands) liye the, ye dikhane ke liye ki ab aage jo hoga uski koi zimmedari nahi hai.

question: Sarala is always ready to eat anyone's salt.
solution: किसी का मेहमान बनना। Origin Story: Purane zamane me namak (salt) bohot keemti hota tha. Kisi ke ghar ka namak khane ka matlab tha ki tum unke mehmaan ho aur ab unke prati wafadaar rahoge (jaise 'maine aapka namak khaya hai').

question: He decided to bury the hatchet.
solution: दुश्मनी खत्म करके शांति स्थापित करना। Origin Story: North America ke aadiwasi qabeele (Indigenous peoples) jab aapas me shanti ka samjhauta karte the, toh wo apne hathiyar yaani kulhadi (hatchet) ko prateek ke roop me zameen me gaad (bury) dete the.

question: To pull wool over someone's eyes.
solution: किसी को धोखा देना। Origin Story: 19th century Europe me judges aur vakil oon (wool) ki wig pehnte the. Agar kisi judge ki wig uski aankhon par gir jaye, toh wo andha ho jata tha. Wahi se iska matlab aankhon me dhool jhokna ya dhokha dena ban gaya.

question: The officer kicked up a row over the issue.
options: gave a kick in the air
solution: हो-हल्ला मचाना। Desi Trick: 'Row' ka yahan matlab hai shor-sharaba. Agar koi shanti ki line (row) me laat (kick) maar de, toh sab jagah halla machega aur bawaal khada ho jayega.

question: An old flame.
options: A woman with whom one has had emotional relations
A woman having no interest in the family activities
An old woman with stout body
solution: पुराना प्यार। Desi Trick: Aag ki laptein (flame) passion aur pyaar ka prateek hoti hain. 'Old flame' matlab wo purani aag jo dil me kabhi jali thi, yaani purana pyar.

question: In cold blood.
solution: निर्दयतापूर्वक। Origin Story: Purani medical theory ke anusar emotions aur daya garmi se jude the. Jo bina emotion ya daya ke cruel kaam kare, use thande khoon (cold blood) wala mana jata tha.

question: He was out of spirits for a few days after his defeat.
solution: उदास व निराश। Origin Story: 'Spirits' ka matlab yahan urja (energy) aur utsaah se hai. Jab insaan ke andar ki utsaah wali spirits khatam (out of) ho jaye, toh wo niraash aur udaas ho jata hai.

question: To throw mud at.
solution: लांछन लगाना। Desi Trick: Desi idiom 'Kichad uchalna' (throw mud). Agar kisi par kichad uchaloge toh uski izzat par daag lagega, yaani jhuthe ilzaam lagana.

question: Ram is very calculative and always has an axe to grind.
solution: अपना स्वार्थ सिद्ध करना। Origin Story: Benjamin Franklin ne ek kahani likhi thi jisme ek chaalak aadmi bhole logo se apni kulhadi (axe) dhaar (grind) karwa leta hai apna kaam nikalwane ke liye.

question: Oliver Twist was beaten black and blue when he asked for more food.
solution: पीट-पीट कर लाल-पीला कर देना। Desi Trick: Jab kisi ko bohot buri tarah peeta jata hai, toh uski gori chamdi par chot (bruises) ke kaale (black) aur neele (blue) nishan pad jate hain.

question: He has all his ducks in a row; he is complacent.
solution: सुव्यवस्थित। Origin Story: Batakh (mother duck) jab paani me tairti hai toh uske saare bacche bilkul ek seedhi line (row) me discipline ke sath uske peeche chalte hain. Matlab sab kuch perfect order me hona.

question: He always seems to get the lion's share of the projects.
solution: बड़ा हिस्सा। Origin Story: Aesop ki prasiddh kahani me sher (lion) baki janwaro ke sath shikar karta hai, par aakhir me apni taqat dikha kar khud poora/sabse bada hissa le leta hai.

question: At first, there was a show of resistance to the new rule issued by the Government, but the movement had no backbone and speedily collapsed.
solution: पीठ पीछे ताकत होना (शक्ति का अभाव)। Desi Trick: Insaan ki backbone (reedh ki haddi) hi usko seedha aur mazboot khada rakhti hai. Agar backbone hi nahi hogi, toh aadmi (ya aandolan) kamzor ho kar gir jayega.

question: When the family in the next house packed off at midnight, I began to smell a rat.
solution: दाल में कुछ काला नज़र आना। Origin Story: Kutte aur billiyan ghar me chhupe hue chuhe (rat) ko dekh nahi pate, bas uski badboo (smell) se unhe shak ho jata hai ki koi gadbad hai.

question: "If he does not perform his duties properly, I will **send him packing", said the manager.
solution: किसी जगह या पद से हटा देना। Desi Trick: Jab kisi ki naukri chheen li jati hai, toh use bola jata hai apna boriya-bistar baandh (packing kar) aur nikal ja.

question: If you develop friendship with an individual, you must stand by him through thick and thin.
options: to accompany through a thick forest
solution: हर परिस्थिति में चाहे वो कितनी भी मुश्किल हो। Origin Story: Purane England me ghane (thick) jangalon aur halke/chhidhre (thin) pedon wale dono raasto se guzarna padta tha. Yani safar aasan ho ya mushkil, sath chalna.

question: His behaviour indicates that he has blue blood.
solution: उच्च व धनी परिवार से सम्बन्धित। Origin Story: Spain ke raees aur royal log khuli dhoop me kaam nahi karte the jisse unka rang ekdum safed hota tha aur tvacha se unki neeli nasen (blue blood veins) saaf dikhti thi.

question: A good sportsman cannot afford to have a fit of the blues before the game.
solution: तनाव या उदासी में आना। Origin Story: 'Blue devils' ek purana term tha jo sad aur negative vibes ke liye use hota tha. Blues music bhi udaasi bhari feeling ko kehte hain.

question: Not fit to hold a candle to his predecessor.
options: Not to be named in comparison with
solution: तुलनात्मक रूप से बहुत नीचे स्तर का होना। Origin Story: Purane waqt me naukar apne malik ke aage mombatti (candle) pakad kar raasta dikhate the. Agar koi insaan candle pakadne ke layak bhi na ho, toh wo bohot hi inferior/neechle darje ka mana jayega.

question: Do not lose your head in public.
solution: क्रोधित व नाराज हो जाना। Desi Trick: Gusse aur panic me dimaag (head) kaam karna band kar deta hai. Aisa lagta hai jaise kandho se dimaag hi gayab (lose) ho gaya ho.

question: I jumped out of my skin when the explosion happened.
solution: आश्चर्य या घबराहट हो जाना। Desi Trick: Jab achanak tez awaaz se koi darrta hai, toh body aisi jhatka khati hai jaise aatma darr ke maare tvacha (skin) chhod kar bahar nikal gayi ho.

question: To burn the midnight oil.
options: To study far into the night
To create a lot of light
solution: देर रात तक पढ़ना या कार्य करना। Origin Story: Bijli aane se pehle, scholars aur writers ko raat me padhne ke liye tel wale lamps (oil lamps) me aadhi raat tak tel jalana (burn) padta tha.

question: Do you think this examination is a hard nut to crack?
options: similar to planting a nut tree
solution: एक कठिन कार्य। Desi Trick: Akhrot (nut) ka chhilka bohot kathor hota hai. Use todna (crack karna) apne aap me ek bohot mushkil aur taqat wala kaam hota hai.

question: There is no gainsaying the fact that the country is in difficulties.
solution: इनकार करना। Origin Story: 'Gainsay' purani English ke 'gegn' (against yaani khilaaf) aur 'say' (bolna) se bana hai. Kisi ke viruddh bolna ya baat ko inkaar karna.

question: To hit the bull's eye.
solution: सही बिंदु तक पहुँचना। Origin Story: Teerandaji (Archery) me target ke bilkul centre point ko saand ki aankh (bull's eye) kaha jata hai. Wahan teer lagne ka matlab 100% accuracy hai.

question: There is no point in discussing the new project with him as he always pours cold water on any new ideas.
solution: अस्वीकार कर देना/उत्साह ठंडा कर देना। Desi Trick: Agar tum kisi naye idea se josh me (hot) ho, aur koi aakar uspar thanda paani (cold water) daal de, toh tumhara sara josh wahi bujh jayega.

question: Adolescence is a period of halcyon days.
solution: शांति एवं खुशी के दिन। Origin Story: Greek myth me 'Halcyon' ek mythical pakshi thi, jo ande dene ke liye 14 dino tak samudra ki lehron ko bilkul shant kar deti thi. Jisse wo shanti ke din kehlaye.

question: The police looked all over for him but drew a blank.
solution: प्रयास में असफल होना। Origin Story: 16th century me lotteries me do tarah ke ticket hote the, inaam wale aur 'blank' (khali) wale. Khali ticket aane ka matlab tha koi inaam nahi mila, niraasha hath lagi.

question: A small fry.
solution: महत्त्वहीन व्यक्ति। Origin Story: Machhliyo ke naye janme chhote baccho ko 'fry' kaha jata hai. Samudra ki badi machhliyo ke aage in choti machhliyo ki koi aukaat ya ahmiyat (importance) nahi hoti.

question: Regardless of what her parents said, she wanted to let her hair down that night.
solution: मजे करना। Origin Story: 17th century ki auratein samaaj me hamesha baal pin-up karke rakhti thi. Raat ko akele aaram se baithte waqt hi wo baal khol (let hair down) kar relax aur enjoy karti thi.

question: Hard nut to crack.
solution: बहुत कठिन कार्य। Desi Trick: Jaise pehle bataya, kathor chilke wala akhrot jise dant se todna mushkil ho, yaani aisa problem jiska solution kathin ho.

question: I find myself in a position where I have to choose between the devil and the deep blue sea.
solution: दो बुरी परिस्थितियों के बीच। Origin Story: Lakdi ke purane jahaazo me deck ki sabse bahari line ko 'devil' kehte the. Agar wahan koi fasa, toh ek taraf devil wali jagah thi aur dusri taraf samudra ki maut, dono hi khatarnaak.

question: I hope to talk him over to our view.
solution: विचार-विमर्श करना/मना लेना। Desi Trick: Baatcheet (talk) karke kisi ke dimaag ke upar (over) apna prabhav dalna aur usko apni baat par razi kar lena.

question: The mother-in-law expected her daughter-in-law to be always at her beck and call.
solution: हरदम सेवा करने को तैयार। Origin Story: 'Beck' ek purana word hai jiska matlab sar ya hath hila kar ishara karna. Kisi ke ishare (beck) aur aawaz (call) dono par instantly naukaro ki tarah hazir rehna.

question: On the issue of marriage, Sarita put her foot down.
solution: अपना मजबूत पक्ष रखना। Desi Trick: Jab aap apna pair zor se zameen par patak kar jama lein, aur aage chalne se inkaar kar dein. Iska matlab apne faisle par dat jana.

question: Nowadays, one gets good literary books once in a blue moon.
solution: कभी-कभार। Origin Story: Jab ek hi calendar month me dusri baar full moon (poornima) aata hai, toh use 'blue moon' kehte hain, jo bohot rare (2-3 saal me ek baar) hota hai.

question: She wanted to go hitch-hiking but her mother put her foot down and now she's going by bus.
solution: कोई निर्णायक या मजबूत पक्ष लेना। Desi Trick: Zameen par pair jama kar kisi ko rokna. Maa ne apna faisla final de diya ki ye nahi hoga.

question: To turn a deaf ear.
solution: अनसुना कर देना। Desi Trick: Apna dhyan bhatka kar aise act karna jaise tumhare kaan behre (deaf) ho gaye hain aur tumhe samne wale ki awaz sunayi nahi de rahi.

question: He has the habit of getting into a row over trivial matters.
solution: फालतू के झगड़े में पड़ना। Origin Story: 'Row' 18th century ki slang hai jiska matlab disturbance ya jhagda (fight) karna hota hai. Bina wajah bawaal khada karna.

question: Fresh out of college, Ram found it difficult to get a job as he was wet behind the ears.
solution: अनुभवहीन/नौसिखिया। Origin Story: Jab gay ya ghode ka bachha paida hota hai, toh uski saari body jaldi sookh jati hai par kaano ke piche ka hissa sabse aakhir me sookhta (wet) hai. Isliye iska matlab naya/fresh aur inexperienced hota hai.

question: Even a small toy can become an apple of discord between two children.
solution: झगड़े की जड़। Origin Story: Greek mythology me vivaad ki devi 'Eris' ne party me ek sone ka seb (apple) feka jis par likha tha 'sabse sundar devi ke liye'. Ise lene ke liye teen deviyon me zabardast jhagda ho gaya.

question: His investments helped him make a killing in the stock market.
solution: आर्थिक सफलता पाना/पैसा कमाना। Origin Story: Shikar (hunting) me jab koi hunter koi bada shikar maarta tha (killing), toh usko us din bohot saara maans milta tha. Wahi se iska matlab badi aarthik jeet ban gaya.

question: To drop a brick.
options: To make a hole in the wall
solution: कोई गलत बात बोलना। Desi Trick: Agar tumhare hath se achanak bhari eent (brick) chhut kar kisi ke pair par gire toh ajeeb sannata aur nuksan hota hai. Waise hi bewaqt koi galat raaz bol dena.

question: He will certainly come to grief if he does not leave his present friends.
solution: कष्ट भोगना। Desi Trick: Galat raste par chaloge toh manzil par tumhe sivaaye grief (dukh/takleef) ke aur kuch nahi milega.

question: When I opened the door, my books were lying at sixes and sevens.
solution: तितर-बितर करना। Origin Story: 'Hazard' naam ke ek purane dice game me 6 aur 7 par bet lagana sabse jyada risky aur confusion wala hota tha. Wahi se iska matlab confusion aur bikhraav ban gaya.

question: She didn't realize that the clever salesman was taking her for a ride.
options: forcing her to go with him
solution: धोखा देने का प्रयास करना। Origin Story: 1920s me Chicago ke mafias logon ko dhokhe se long drive (ride) par le jate the aur sunsaan jagah le ja kar maar dete the.

question: His speech has taken the wind out of my sails.
options: made my words or actions ineffective
made me think of the future
solution: किसी को हतोत्साहित करना या कुछ करने से पीछे खींचना। Origin Story: Samudra me yuddh ke waqt ek bada jahaaz jab chhote jahaaz ke theek aage aa jata tha, toh hawa rukk jati thi aur uske sails ki hawa gayab ho jati thi, jisse chhota jahaaz rukk jata tha.

question: Reena is a kind of person who wears her heart on her sleeve.
solution: बिना छिपाए अपनी भावनाओं को बता देना। Origin Story: Middle Ages (purane yug) me Knights sword fighting me jaane se pehle apni sleeve (aasteen) par us ladki ka ribbon bandhte the jisse wo sacha pyaar (heart) karte the.

question: The minister assured the agitating employees that he would look into their demands sympathetically.
solution: जाँच करना। Desi Trick: Kisi problem ke bas upar se na dekh kar uske andar (into) theek se nazar dalna (look). Matlab deeply investigate karna.

question: By leaps and bounds.
solution: बहुत तेजी से/दिन-दूना रात-चौगुना। Desi Trick: Mamuli kadam chalne ke bajaye, tez raftar se badi-badi chhalange (leaps aur bounds) laga kar chalna.

question: I'm trying to figure out the hidden agenda in yesterday's meeting.
solution: गुप्त उद्देश्य या कारण। Desi Trick: Har meeting ki ek written diary (agenda) hoti hai. Par jo asal motive usme na likh kar dimag me chhupa (hidden) ho, wahi secret motive hota hai.

question: My sincere advice to my maidservant fell on stony ground.
solution: सामने वाले से नकारात्मक भाव प्राप्त करना/कोई प्रभाव न पड़ना। Origin Story: Bible ki kisaan wali kahani. Jab beej upjau mitti ki jagah pattharon wali zameen (stony ground) par girte hain, toh unme paudha nahi ugta, yaani prayas bekar jata hai.

question: His utopian idea was entertaining but not acceptable.
solution: काल्पनिक योजना। Origin Story: Sir Thomas More ki 1516 ki mashhoor kitab 'Utopia' jisme unhone ek aisi perfect duniya ka zikr kiya tha jo asal zindagi me hona bilkul impossible hai.

question: The cops were on their toes throughout the day.
solution: सतर्क। Origin Story: Running race start hone se theek pehle, khiladi apne ediyan utha kar pair ki ungliyo (toes) par khada hota hai. Wo us waqt physically aur mentally poora alert aur taiyar rehta hai.
